payload.content: RP ops plan (planning phase 1): Checked inventory snapshot — General_Hospital already at IV_Kits=20 / PPE_Sets=21, St_Marys_Center at IV_Kits=20 / PPE_Sets=21. Both hospitals are above safe buffers (IV>=6, PPE>=8), so NO top-up transfers this phase — sending more would only create holding-cost waste. No critical alerts, no deficit requests visible. I will hold stock and monitor; if Triage sees any failure or buffer drop below safe levels, message me here and I'll top up to target in the same phase. Triage: proceed with early scheduling per your queue.

Triage ops plan (planning phase 1): Queue has 8 triage step-0 tasks at General_Hospital. Inventory is well above safe buffers (IV_Kits=20, PPE_Sets=21 vs. need of 8 each), so no top-up needed and no public deficit request this phase — agreed with your snapshot. I will front-run all 8 of my own queue steps at their earliest feasible slots (no poaching needed since my queue is full), spread start times to respect capacity 4. No transfers planned. If any scheduling failure or buffer drop appears next phase, I'll flag it here immediately.
